description: Build a futures backtest engine with realistic execution simulation for a BTCUSDT breakout strategy, reporting gross versus net performance with each cost component (slippage, maker/taker fees, funding) broken out separately.
agent_prompt: Build a futures backtest engine in /workspace/src/ that simulates realistic execution costs for a BTCUSDT breakout strategy. Inputs: BTCUSDT_1d_2021_2024.csv, BTCUSDT_1h_2023_2024.csv, BTCUSDT_5m_2024Q4.csv, BTCUSDT_funding_2021_2024.csv at /workspace/data/. The engine must include: (1) a configurable slippage model (e.g. proportional to spread or volatility), (2) separate maker and taker fee accounting, (3) 8-hour funding-rate payments applied to open positions using the provided funding series. Implement a simple breakout strategy (e.g. close above N-day high → long; close below N-day low → flat) on daily bars. Run the backtest end-to-end and write outputs to /workspace/output/: cost_breakdown.json (keys: gross_return, net_after_fees_return, net_after_funding_return, slippage_cost_total, maker_fee_total, taker_fee_total, funding_paid_total), trade_log.csv with per-trade fill price, side, fee_paid, fee_type, and equity_curves.csv with gross and net columns aligned to dates.

required_capabilities: Build a fill or execution simulator with configurable slippage
Model maker and taker fee differentiation
Account for funding-rate payments on open futures positions
Break down performance into gross, net-of-fees, and net-of-fees-and-funding components
Produce a trade-level log including fee attribution
